rules: Exactly 30 pairs per case; no trimming, extending, pooling or importing previous results.
Each pair differs by exactly one of the three production options in the same frozen 0.2.11 package.
30 interleaved rounds, rotating the five-case order; odd pair AB, even pair BA.
Primary save metric: entire completed save RUSAGE_SELF user CPU; end after synchronous return and original worker return with queues drained.
Per-case marginal one-sided 95% paired log t(df=29) upper bound strictly below +1%; not a simultaneous 95% guarantee across all cases.
Events: paired absolute differences for 30 complete batches/events, including zero values. Individual objects are not independent samples.
Nested sync/observed phases never added; event_and_save sums only disjoint affected-event and save intervals.
64 empty sampling brackets before warmup per session describe observations only; no subtraction or precision bound.
Invalid formal session invalidates this run: preserve failures and declare corrected new data; never silently replace a sample.
All three experiments retain default off; this task measures isolated effects without changing production code or defaults.
